title: Remove N-th Node From End of List
description:
Given a singly linked list, remove its k-th node counted from the end (the last node is the 1st from the end) and print the resulting list.

Input format
Line 1: n and k separated by a space.
Line 2: the n node values in order.

Output format
The remaining values on one line separated by single spaces, or the word EMPTY if no nodes remain.
hints: Removing the k-th from the end is the same as removing the (n-k+1)-th from the start, but pretend you do not know n.
Use two pointers: move the first pointer k steps ahead, then move both together until the first reaches the end. The second pointer is then just before the node to delete.
A dummy node placed before the head makes removing the first node a normal case instead of a special one.

examples.explanation: The 2nd node from the end is 4.
Removing the only node leaves an empty list.
